text:
maria.product: Quick sync — I pulled together a proposed prioritization for the enterprise compliance work (audit log schema, BYOK/KMS UX, SOC2 control mapping, retention tiers). Need quick alignment before sprint planning. TL;DR: propose landing audit schema + minimal BYOK handshake v1 in next release, defer deep KMS escrow & cross-region proofs to Q3.

olivia.security: skimmed — appreciate the TL;DR. Two asks: 1) we need a mapping doc from our audit events => SOC2/ISO controls (auditability evidence). 2) Legal hold behavior must be explicit in retention flow (can't delete during hold).

leo_sre: noted on legal hold. From infra side, adding hold flag impacts our compaction job + cold-archive lifecycle. Could add a metadata bit but needs retention index change. That affects cost estimate.

ajenkins: from product/engineering tradeoffs — shipping audit schema early helps integrations (customers already asking for structured fields). But BYOK handshake v1 needs a KMS API shim + key metadata store. We can do a light handshake (upload public key + thumbprint) without full escrow.

sam.sales: a couple of pilot customers (FinServCo, Medlytics) said BYOK is make-or-break. They will accept handshake v1 as long as SLA wording covers key custody and we've got a clear ops runbook.

maria.product: proposed scope for next release (sprint N+1):
- audit schema v1 (structured events for auth, model selection, prompt hashes, response hashes)
- retention tiers: hot(30d)/warm(180d)/cold(archival) + legal-hold override flag
- BYOK handshake v1: customer uploads key metadata + we store key id + KMS type; no escrow/rotation automation yet
Can we confirm impact/risk?

olivia.security: sounds reasonable. Add acceptance criteria: 1) evidence extraction for SOC2 control CC6.1 (log collection) demonstrated with example queries; 2) retention+legal hold documented; 3) KMS metadata stored encrypted-at-rest.

leo_sre: implementation notes:
```
- retention_index: int -> store per-tenant
- legal_hold: bool -> prevents deletion in compaction job
- archive_job: respects legal_hold and retention_index
```
We need +2 days infra work and +1 ops test cycle.

ajenkins: engineering estimates: audit schema v1 (3 dev days + 1 QA), retention toggles + legal hold (4 dev days + 2 QA), BYOK handshake v1 (5 dev days + 2 QA + docs). Total ~13 dev days across backend teams. If we parallelize, target ship in 3 weeks.

sam.sales: can we surface an interim doc for customers? a short spec they can sign off on for pilot.

maria.product: yes — I can draft a pilot spec today. Action items I propose:
- maria.product: draft pilot spec + acceptance checklist (due: 48h)
- ajenkins: confirm implementation plan & break down tickets (due: 24h)
- leo_sre: infra changes + estimate for storage cost delta (due: 48h)
- olivia.security: draft SOC2 mapping snippet & KMS encryption reqs (due: 48h)
- sam.sales: collect pilot customer legal contacts and share pilot commitment (due: 72h)

olivia.security: one more constraint — for SOC2 evidence we need immutable append-only logs for the model decision path (model version + prompt hash -> response hash). Make sure schema includes those fields.

ajenkins: will add model_version, prompt_hash, response_hash fields to event schema. Also propose adding a `decision_trace_id` to stitch multi-request flows.

leo_sre: +1 on decision_trace_id. Also note archive storage encryption at rest must remain tenant-separable for Dedicated/Private customers. That impacts key rotation later.

maria.product: good. If everyone ok, I'll create the RFC + pilot spec and we sync async. If any blockers speak now. :thumbsup:

sam.sales: :thumbsup: customers briefed, they want pilot sign-off next week.

deploy-bot: Reminder: upcoming deploy window Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC. Non-blocking infra changes should land after that.

ajenkins: ack. We'll aim to land PRs after deploy window unless urgent.

maria.product: thanks all — I'll post the draft RFC in #product in ~4h and link here. Closing thread for planning unless new objections.
